what_implemented: A PURE, INERT design-only contract for HOW HERMES will LATER reference and verify a governed external authority + issuer-attestation boundary (FUT-1, the first future gate of the merged FW-08 real-proof lifecycle).

ExternalAuthorityReadiness frozen dataclass (EV-03 authority-readiness record): binds authority_root/external-authority reference, resolver identity reference, trust-anchor reference, issuer-identity reference, attestation-policy reference, evidence references, expiry/rotation validity_end reference, provenance, fault/fail-closed fields, a readiness_digest and a module-issuer seal. References ONLY; no signing/private material fields.

validate_authority_readiness: reject-not-repair validator covering type, digest tamper, seal forgery/relabel, synthetic-in-real-mode, bad state/class, revoked/invalid, missing references, non-UTC, expiry, contract version, wrong stage, missing provenance, inline-payload reference confusion, and caller-supplied signing material.

ExternalAuthorityVerifier ABC exposing ONLY verify_authority_evidence (no sign/issue/mint/key methods); ProductionExternalAuthorityVerifier raises ExternalAuthorityUnavailable; SyntheticExternalAuthorityVerifier is module-token gated and deterministic.

require_verifier_only / select_production_verifier / verify_readiness_no_caller_trust_loop: the verifier-only boundary, the module-owned production-verifier selection (unavailable here), and the no-caller-owned-trust-loop guard.

IssuerAttestationReference frozen dataclass + validate_issuer_attestation_reference: a reference to the issuer-attestation boundary with no signed payload / private material / mock credential embedded; rejects inline payload, missing issuer/authority-root/attestation refs, digest tamper, and any self-issuance (EAR-IA-SELF-ISSUED).
_ReadinessIssuer (ephemeral in-process HMAC, name-mangled key, no getter), _MODULE_ISSUER singleton, _READINESS_TOKEN module-private sentinel — mirroring F2-R1 _ModuleVerifier / _ProofIssuer.
eventual_evidence_record_ids() extending the D-PR120-EV-TAIL sequence with EV-03-AUTHORITY-READINESS.
what_not_implemented: NO real HSM / KMS / external signer / production isolation is created or claimed.
NO external authority is configured, registered, or resolved.
NO keys, secrets, credentials, or signing material are created, stored, or embedded anywhere.
NO signing / issuance / minting capability is exposed on any interface.
NO runtime is touched; the module is not imported by runtime; no I/O, subprocess, network, filesystem, or environment lookup is performed.
NO build-producer registration (that is the next held stage 4).

readiness_model.classification_setter: C-PR122-EAR-PROMOTION: public construction (new_external_authority_readiness) is SYNTHETIC-ONLY and REJECTS any caller-selected non-synthetic classification with EARPromotionForbidden (not silently repaired). The module seal is INTEGRITY metadata for synthetic contract objects only — NOT external authority, a trust anchor, a production issuer, HSM/KMS evidence, or permission to enter real mode. It does NOT by itself prevent synthetic-to-real promotion.
readiness_model.real_mode_unconditional_fail_closed: validate_authority_readiness(real_mode=True) returns ('EAR-PRODUCTION-AUTHORITY-UNAVAILABLE',) whenever production_external_authority_available() is False — FIRST, before any seal/classification/reference is considered, and independent of the constructor/issuer/reflection. A freshly-minted, correctly-sealed REAL record (via a reflective/object.__new__ path) still fails on unavailability, NOT on an invalid seal.
readiness_model.evidence_record: EV-03 authority-readiness record: authority_root reference, resolver identity, verifier interface, revocation source, expiry/rotation policy references

validator.posture: reject-not-repair, fail-closed, sorted reason tuple, () iff valid

verifier_only_boundary.interface: ExternalAuthorityVerifier ABC with ONLY verify_authority_evidence(readiness, evidence_reference, now_utc) -> (bool, reasons)
verifier_only_boundary.no_caller_trust_loop: verify_readiness_no_caller_trust_loop: caller-supplied verifier in real mode -> EAR-CALLER-OWNED-TRUST-LOOP; module boundary is the only source of a real verifier and it is unavailable -> fail closed

limitations: L-F2R3-REFLECTIVE is closed ONLY at the CONTRACT boundary — the module seal is an ephemeral in-process HMAC (a reflective key), NOT a real external signer. Same residual posture as F2-R1's _ModuleVerifier / F2-R3's _ProofIssuer.
Real HSM / KMS / external-signer / production isolation is NOT claimed and does NOT exist.
The verifier-only interface proves the SHAPE of the future boundary; a real external verifier is outstanding (stage 4+).
future_authority_integration_requirement: Configure a real governed external authority root (HSM/KMS/external signer) rooted OUTSIDE the HERMES app boundary.
Bind ProductionExternalAuthorityVerifier to a real external verifier that returns attestations from that authority; the HERMES app must never hold signing/private material.
Source revocation and expiry/rotation from the external authority at USE, re-checked, fail-closed.
Register build producers (stage 4) only after AUTHORITY_READY is established through the real external boundary.
prohibited_interpretations: This contract does NOT mean a real HSM/KMS/external signer exists.
AUTHORITY_READY minted here is SYNTHETIC and test-only; it never certifies a real external authority.
The module seal is NOT production signing authority; it is an ephemeral in-process integrity seal.
No output of this contract authorises execution, publication, deployment, or any runtime change.
acceptance_tests: Synthetic AUTHORITY_READY accepted only in synthetic mode; the SAME record rejected under real_mode (EAR-SYNTHETIC-IN-REAL-MODE).
Missing authority/trust-anchor/issuer/attestation-policy/evidence references each rejected with the exact code.
Non-UTC, expired, unsupported contract version, wrong lifecycle stage, missing provenance each rejected.
Caller-supplied verifier in real mode -> EAR-CALLER-OWNED-TRUST-LOOP; caller supplying authority AND verifier rejected.
Relabel synthetic->real breaks the seal (EAR-SEAL-INVALID); subclass/proxy cannot relabel; monkeypatched authority cannot bypass classification.
Copied evidence payload cannot substitute for a governed evidence reference (EAR-REFERENCE-IS-INLINE-PAYLOAD).
Secret-scan: module + JSON + MD contain no private-key block / raw credential / bearer token / secret env default.
Inertness: module performs no open()/os.environ/getenv/socket/subprocess/requests/urllib/Path and no import-time I/O.
